lines.en: - Everyone, before everyone else gets here,
I'd like to make a little toast.
My romantic life has been a bit of a mixed bag lately,
and when that's the case, it's hard not to be cynical
but it's couples like you that give hope to the rest of us.
Leslie, you deserve the best, and you found it.
Ben, don't you dare hurt her.
- Okay, I'm not planning on hurting her.
- Hey, Ben, you best watch yourself.
- Why would any of you think I would hurt Leslie?
- This was literally the most beautiful
and moving thing that I have ever heard.
Take all the time you need.
